name: AL Language XApp H
brief: Cross-app fixture H: an app whose logo is a 16 x 8 baseline JPEG and that registers an assisted setup when the login raises OnRegisterAssistedSetup.
description: Holds a 16 x 8 baseline JPEG (633 bytes) as the app logo and one OnRegisterAssistedSetup subscriber (tests/al-language-onprem/session-system/UsAppLogoJpegSizes.al). Depends on System Application and Base Application only; no app depends on it. It is published last, after cross-app fixture E, so it changes no subscriber order of the other fixtures. The app id, name and publisher are fixed: the probe reads them.
